Late Drama Seals Victory for Utrecht Over NAC Breda A dramatic late surge saw FC Utrecht secure a crucial victory against NAC Breda on May 2, 2026, in a closely contested Eredivisie fixture at the Galgenwaard Stadium . First Half Stalemate Tinged with Red Card Drama The opening period of the match was a cagey affair, with neither side able to break the deadlock. Chances were at a premium, though FC Utrecht showed flashes of intent, including a header from Mike Eerdhuijzen and a corner from Souffian El Karouani , both dealt with by NAC Breda goalkeeper Daniel Bielica . The visitors also probed, with Lewis Holtby delivering a corner, but the FC Utrecht defence stood firm. The complexion of the game shifted dramatically in the 35th minute when Mohamed Nassoh of NAC Breda received a yellow card, which was subsequently reviewed and upgraded to a straight red card, leaving the away side with a significant disadvantage for the remainder of the match. Second Half Intensity Builds Towards a Late Climax Emerging for the second half a man down, NAC Breda adopted a more defensive posture, while FC Utrecht looked to exploit their numerical advantage. Substitutions were made by both sides, with Jesper Karlsson being introduced early for FC Utrecht to inject more attacking impetus. Despite the pressure, NAC Breda defended resolutely, with Daniel Bielica making several key saves. The home side dominated possession, controlling 65% of the ball by the final whistle, but struggled to find a breakthrough against a determined NAC Breda team. The game appeared to be heading towards a goalless draw until the dying moments. Frenetic Finale: De Wit and Blake Strike Twice Just as frustration began to set in for the home crowd, FC Utrecht finally found the net in the 86th minute. Jesper Karlsson whipped in a corner from the left, and Dani de Wit was on hand to tap the ball in, giving FC Utrecht a vital lead. The drama, however, was far from over. In the 90+9th minute, David Min played a key role, providing the assist for Adrian Blake , who calmly finished to double FC Utrecht 's advantage and seal a dramatic 2-0 victory. NAC Breda fought until the end but could not find a way back into the game. The attendance for the match was 23034.

The Eredivisie clash on May 11, 2026 , delivered a high-octane spectacle as two determined sides battled for supremacy under the floodlights. Fans were treated to a rollercoaster of emotions as the tactical battle evolved from a dominant opening into a chaotic and unpredictable finish. AZ Alkmaar’s Explosive Opening The match began with a flurry of activity as AZ Alkmaar looked to impose their will early on. It took only eight minutes for the deadlock to be broken when Troy Parrott found space to deliver a precise assist for Sven Mijnans , whose clinical finish with his left foot sent the visitors into an early lead. The momentum stayed firmly with the away side, and by the 12th minute, they had doubled their advantage. Mateo Chavez capitalized on a key pass from Sven Mijnans , slotting the ball home with his left foot to leave NAC Breda reeling in the opening stages of the contest. NAC Breda Fights Back Despite the early setbacks, NAC Breda refused to surrender, slowly finding their footing as the match progressed into the second half. The comeback began in earnest in the 61st minute when Cherrion Valerius delivered a pinpoint cross for Moussa Soumano , who rose highest to head the ball home and ignite the home crowd. Ten minutes later, the momentum shifted completely as Fredrik Oldrup Jensen teed up Moussa Soumano once more; the forward struck a powerful right-footed effort from outside the box to bring the scores level and set up a grandstand finish. A Breathless Finale The closing stages of the match on this 2026-05-11 evening were nothing short of extraordinary. In the 89th minute, Juho Talvitie seemed to have completed the miracle turnaround for NAC Breda , firing a left-footed shot from distance into the back of the net following another assist from Cherrion Valerius . However, the celebrations were short-lived. In the 90th minute, Mexx Meerdink found a way through for AZ Alkmaar , beating the keeper with a right-footed strike from outside the area after being set up by Weslley Pinto . Despite late pressure and several corners for the visitors, the referee blew the final whistle on a pulsating 3-3 draw.
